channel.title: Journey Home
channel.desc: Vijaya was raised Methodist in India, but some painful experiences in her youth led her to mistrust God as Father, and she stopped praying in her teens. She went on to become a scientist, and abandoned religion altogether for years. After 9/11, she and her American husband began to read Bible stories to their children, but didn?t know which church to go back to. The denominations she?d left had changed dramatically in the decades she was away, and the only solid rock she and her family could find was the Catholic Church. (60 minutes).
